dedupe_keys.name: glocab cropland field boundary dataset brazil ukraine usa canada and russia

description: This vector dataset has 190,832 manually digitised cropland field boundaries with attributes in 22 regions of 74 to 38,000 km2 across Brazil, Ukraine, the United States, Canada and Russia, drawn over 20 m Sentinel-2 imagery for a range of dominant crop types and time periods. The Zenodo record says it is a by-product of the Global Cropland Area Burned (GloCAB) product for mid-2002 to 2020. It was published in January 2024 (version 1.0) by researchers at the University of Maryland Department of Geographical Sciences under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip of about 17 MB with a readme. Coverage is 22 sample regions in five countries. Caveats: regions are samples, not national coverage, and dates vary by region. For simulation it gives real field shapes and sizes to train field delineation and to model field-level crop fire and hazard exposure. Related catalogue records include NECCPB-1 parcel boundaries and the Trazo field boundaries for South America.
name: GloCAB cropland field boundary dataset (Brazil, Ukraine, USA, Canada and Russia)
provider: University of Maryland Department of Geographical Sciences - Joanne Hall, Fernanda Argueta and Louis Giglio, via Zenodo
